# HTML blocks and embeds

A markdown link in an HTML block:

<details>
See [doc](doc.md) and [deep](sub/deep.md)
</details>

<div>[x](y.md)</div>

Escaped \[[a]] x and markup [[a *b* c]] and section [[a#sec|S]].

Embeds ![[pic.png]] and ![[sub/pic.png]] and ![[sub/e]].

A code span in a label [a `]` b](sub/x.md).
